notes:
## What's new
- Support RPG Maker VX Ace (.rvdata2), VX (.rvdata) and XP (.rxdata) saves
- Item, switch and variable names are read from the game's Data folder or its encrypted archive (Game.rgss3a / .rgss2a / .rgssad)
- XP/VX/VX Ace saves are rewritten losslessly: data from game-specific scripts is kept as-is

## Fixes
- Party edits the right character; EXP uses the character's current class
- Level is limited to 1–99 for XP/VX/VX Ace (higher levels crash the game menu)
- Saving now reports errors instead of always showing "File Saved!"
- Security updates: Tauri 2.12 and other dependencies

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/truongthang2211/RPGSaveEditor/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0
